responsibility: Implements gm2’s reserved-word and token-name tables by interning all punctuation, keywords, and selected extensions into `NameKey` form and indexing them through `SymbolKey` trees in both directions. It owns initialization of the canonical token `Name` values, recognizes reserved identifiers and the EOF marker, and provides the enum-to-name conversion used by parser diagnostics and grammar-generated code.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file implements reserved-word recognition by interning punctuation and keywords and building the bidirectional lookup trees used by `IsReserved` and `tokToTok`; the same-name `.def` file only declares that token API and shared names.
